ruleHint.SCHEDULE_SLIPPAGE: Physical progress is behind the milestone baseline by more than the configured threshold.
ruleHint.COST_OVERRUN: Certified expenditure outpaces earned value (CPI below threshold), projecting a cost overrun at completion.
ruleHint.STALLED_REPORTING: No progress report has been received from the site for longer than the configured number of days.
ruleHint.MILESTONE_OVERDUE: A baseline milestone passed its planned date without being achieved.
ruleHint.DISBURSEMENT_LAG: A planned funding tranche has not been released within the configured lag.
ruleHint.SEVERE_DAMAGE_UNADDRESSED: A facility assessed as severely damaged or destroyed has no reconstruction project assigned.
ruleHint.QUALITY_NONCONFORMANCE: An inspection recorded a quality non-conformance.
ruleHint.FIELD_VERIFICATION_OVERDUE: Reported progress has not been independently verified by a field inspection for longer than twice the evidence-staleness threshold.
ruleHint.PROGRESS_DISCREPANCY: A field inspection observed materially less physical progress than the site reported.
